basic_details.short_information: District Medical and Health Officer Nizamabad (DMHO Nizamabad) has notified vacancies for Nutrition Counselors, Pediatrician/Medical Officer, Staff Nurses, ANM, Lab Technician, Pharmacist, Psychologist, Senior Dots plus TB HIV Supervisor, and Public Health Manager posts under its 2026 recruitment. The engagement is on a contract or outsourcing basis for a period of 1 year or till the actual need ceases, whichever is earlier. Notified pay scales include Rs. 22,750 for Nutrition Counselors, Rs. 1,00,000 or Rs. 52,000 for Pediatrician/Medical Officer, Rs. 29,900 for Staff Nurses, and Rs. 27,300 f

faq.question: Q1. When is the DM&HO Nizamabad NHM walk-in drive?
faq.answer: The walk-in drive is on 29 October 2026, from 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM. It is for Pediatrician/Medical Officer, Nutrition Counselor, Public Health Manager and Psychologist.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DM&HO Nizamabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 9 vacancies, 1 for each post, because the notice does not print a number. Four posts are filled through the walk-in drive and five through applications submitted at the office.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Staff Nurse, ANM, Lab Technician, Pharmacist and Senior Dots plus TB HIV Supervisor?
faq.answer: Applications for these five posts are received from 26 October 2026 to 31 October 2026. The last date is 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Where are applications for the Sl.No. 2 posts submitted?
faq.answer: They are submitted at Room No. 201, IDOC, Office of the District Medical & Health Officer, Nizamabad.

faq.question: Q5. What documents should I bring to the DM&HO Nizamabad walk-in drive?
faq.answer: Bring all relevant certificates, including the original certificate(s). This applies to Pediatrician/Medical Officer, Nutrition Counselor, Public Health Manager and Psychologist candidates on 29 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. Are the DM&HO Nizamabad NHM posts permanent?
faq.answer: No. The posts are filled on a Contract/Outsourcing basis under the National Health Mission (NHM) in Nizamabad district.

faq.question: Q7. Where can I get the DM&HO Nizamabad NHM application form?
faq.answer: The notice says the application form and guidelines are to be displayed on the official website, nizamabad.telangana.gov.in.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for DM&HO Nizamabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The vacancies are under the National Health Mission (NHM) in Nizamabad district, Telangana.
